subject: PUBLIC SCHEDULE FOR MAYOR ZOHRAN KWAME MAMDANI FOR THURSDAY, JUNE 4, 2026
plaintextBody:
City Seal 170

June 3, 2026 

*FOR PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY*   

*CONTACT:* pressoffice@cityhall.nyc.gov    

   

*PUBLIC SCHEDULE FOR MAYOR ZOHRAN KWAME MAMDANI*   

*FOR THURSDAY, JUNE 4, 2026* 

   

"On Thursday, Mayor Mamdani will hold a press conference with Governor Kathy Hochul to brief New Yorkers on World Cup transportation and preparedness efforts. This event is open to press. ""Media interested in attending must RSVP to ""press.rsvp@exec.ny.gov" <press.rsvp@exec.ny.gov>"" 

"" 

"After, the Mayor will deliver the keynote address at Borough of Manhattan Community College — CUNY Commencement Ceremony. This event is open to press. ""Media interested in attending must RSVP at ""jlyon@bmcc.cuny.edu." <jlyon@bmcc.cuny.edu> 

"" 

"Later, the Mayor will host the second “Talk With The People” live stream. ""This event will be streamed live on ""Twitch" [ https://twitch.tv/nyc_mayor?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""YouTube" [ https://www.youtube.com/nycmayorsoffice?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""Instagram" [ https://instagram.com/nycmayor/?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""Facebook" [ https://facebook.com/NYCMayor/?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""X" [ https://x.com/NYCMayor?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""BlueSky" [ https://bsky.app/profile/mayor.nyc.gov?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]" and ""TikTok" [ https://tiktok.com/@nycmayor?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]"." 

  

_*Press Schedule*_:" "   

  

*10:00 AM – Holds a Press Conference with Governor Kathy Hochul to Brief New Yorkers on World Cup Transportation and Preparedness Efforts* 

"Media interested in attending must RSVP to ""press.rsvp@exec.ny.gov." <press.rsvp@exec.ny.gov>

"This event will be ""streamed live" [ https://www.nyc.gov/main?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]" and available on Encompass Port CTY-3653."   

"The Mayor will take questions at this event." 

"" 

*12:00 PM (Approx.) – Delivers Keynote Address at Borough of Manhattan Community College — CUNY Commencement Ceremony* 

"Barclays Center; 620 Atlantic Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11217." 

"This event is open to press. Media interested in attending must RSVP at ""jlyon@bmcc.cuny.edu." <jlyon@bmcc.cuny.edu> 

"" 

*7:00 PM – Hosts Second “Talk With The People” Live Stream* 

"The Mayor will take questions from the public via the Twitch comment section.   " 

"This event will be streamed live on ""Twitch" [ https://twitch.tv/nyc_mayor?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""YouTube" [ https://www.youtube.com/nycmayorsoffice?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""Instagram" [ https://instagram.com/nycmayor/?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""Facebook" [ https://facebook.com/NYCMayor/?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""X" [ https://x.com/NYCMayor?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""BlueSky" [ https://bsky.app/profile/mayor.nyc.gov?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]" and ""TikTok" [ https://tiktok.com/@nycmayor?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]"." 

""
